```{r include=FALSE}

cor_results$estimate %>% round(digits = 2)

cor_results$p.value %>% format.pval(., eps = .001)
```


Speed and distance were correlated (see Figure 1), *r* = `r cor_results$estimate %>% round(digits = 2)`, p `r cor_results$p.value %>% format.pval(., eps = .001)`.
